correctness.rationale: Over geometric splitting E=kbar^6, singular gradient of cubic sum x_i^3 subject sum x_i=0 gives coordinates ±a and exactly three plus, three minus for p≥7; ten nodes. Opposite-pair equations give fifteen pairing planes; a node lies in a plane exactly when each matching edge crosses its triple partition. Hence 60 flags of degrees 6 (nodes) and 4 (planes). Frobenius acts on six embeddings as permutation type factor partition; all k-extension counts and zeta follow from cycle lengths. Independently enumerated all ten bipartitions, fifteen matchings, sixty incidences and all 720 permutations and matched entire eleven-type table and the two absence-of-rational-incidence cases. Inspected source verify.py and confirmed orbit algorithm and finite exhaustive domain. No claim about full cubic zeta or full possibly nonreduced Fano scheme.
